title: EU’s Rule of Law Report Risks Becoming Toothless, Says Liberties
summary: According to Liberties’ analysis, at least 96 per cent of the EU Commission’s recommendations have not been fully implemented, and 54 per cent show no or only limited progress.

title: After Trump’s lash at Zelensky, EU’s Kubilius says Europe needs independent peace strategy
summary: European Union Defence Commissioner Andrius Kubilius said Sunday that Europe and Kyiv should consider developing an independent strategy for achieving peace in Ukraine, following US President Donald Trump’s criticism of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
